lines.en: I have a history of chasing my tail but a track record clean of having ever caught it.
lines.zh: 我有追着自己尾巴跑的前科,却从未有过咬住它的记录。

lines.en: What this means is that when something larger and scarier than me does appear and ultimately scoop me up with its endless, half-transparent arms that I will not yet be accustomed to how it feels to be held.
lines.zh: 也就是说,当某个比我更庞大、更可怕的东西出现,用它那无穷无尽、半透明的手臂把我捞起时,我还不会习惯「被捧在手里」的感觉。

lines.en: There are many things in life I do not understand.
lines.zh: 人生中有很多事我不理解。

lines.en: Like dust particles. Or the romanticization of death. Or even myself at times as this jar I’m trapped inside reflects not the me that I see but the one that you do.
lines.zh: 比如尘埃。比如对死亡的浪漫化。再比如——某些时刻的我自己:我被困其中的这个罐子,映出的不是我所看见的我,而是你看见的那个我。

lines.en: Yet, what sleeps inside it is a mystery to all of us.
lines.zh: 然而,罐中沉睡的究竟是什么,是我们所有人的谜。

lines.en: When I was younger and the ring still fit my ankle, I worried not of what it meant to die but simply that of dying.
lines.zh: 小时候,当那个环还套得进我的脚踝时,我担心的不是死亡意味着什么,只是害怕死这件事本身。

lines.en: But as my bones expanded, my worries flipped and now I think the opposite.
lines.zh: 可随着骨骼撑开,我的忧虑掉了个头,如今我想的恰恰相反。

lines.en: At this stage in my life, it is not the act of dying that keeps me up at night, but the fear of what comes after.
lines.zh: 在我人生的这个阶段,让我夜不能寐的不是「死」这个动作,而是对死后之事的恐惧。

lines.en: My hands grace the glass of my infinite jar, staring back at someone I can only view as the protagonist of this story while the only thing that truly matters is the glass itself.
lines.zh: 我的手抚过那只无限之罐的玻璃,凝视着那个我只能视为本篇主角的人——而真正重要的,从来只有玻璃本身。

lines.en: If that shatters, what comes next?
lines.zh: 如果它碎了,接下来会怎样?

lines.en: How will the creature (Me) inside of it (The jar) appear to the untrained eye when filled with shards of my former home and other assorted shrapnel and foreign objects?
lines.zh: 当罐中之物(我)被灌满前居所的碎片与其他杂七杂八的弹片与异物,在未经训练的眼睛看来,会是什么模样?

lines.en: For even if my breathing were to continue after such a tragic event, I’d not be seen as who I am but who I was.
lines.zh: 因为就算这般惨剧之后我仍在呼吸,人们看到的也不再是此刻的我,而是曾经的我。

lines.en: There is no moral to this untimely, rhetorical passing- but I don’t think there needs to be.
lines.zh: 这场不合时宜、设问式的逝去并没有寓意——但我想,也不需要。

lines.en: So long as you can imagine what it feels like walking mile after mile in these shoes filled with tacks, my words will have worked.
lines.zh: 只要你能想象,穿着这双钉满图钉的鞋走了一里又一里是什么滋味,我的话就没有白说。

lines.en: So long as you can relate, it will have all been worth it.
lines.zh: 只要你能共情,这一切就都值得。

lines.en: That’s likely what I’d think as the light drains from my eyes.
lines.zh: 这大概就是我眼中的光渐渐熄灭时,心里在想的话。

lines.en: I lied about the lying. Things have been looking up.
lines.zh: 关于说谎的谎,我收回。最近一切都在好转。

lines.en: Feelings are good and I am supposed to have them.
lines.zh: 有情绪是好事,而且我理应拥有它们。

lines.en: There’s nothing I need to fix because the world will fix it for me. All I have to do is live my life and smile and forget but also accept the things I forgot and couldn’t accept but that’s hard when my brain is a brain and-
lines.zh: 没有什么需要我修复的,因为世界会替我修好。我只需要过好日子、保持微笑、然后遗忘——同时也接纳我忘掉的、和没能接纳的东西——可我的脑子是个脑子,这做起来就难——

lines.en: Slow down.
lines.zh: 慢下来。

lines.en: Deep breaths.
lines.zh: 深呼吸。

lines.en: Expel your worries from the depths of your lungs.
lines.zh: 把忧虑从肺腑深处吐出去。

lines.en: You are you.
lines.zh: 你是你。

lines.en: I am me.
lines.zh: 我是我。

lines.en: And neither one of us knows which is which and when.
lines.zh: 而我们俩谁也不知道,哪个是哪个,何时是何时。

lines.en: Warble, warble, warble.
lines.zh: 莺啭,莺啭,莺啭。

lines.en: My phone goes off roughly thirteen feet from the next streetlight.
lines.zh: 我的手机在距离下一盏路灯大约十三英尺的地方响了。

lines.en: I make sure to stand beneath it when I answer.
lines.zh: 接电话时,我特意站到了灯下。

lines.en: : Hel-
: SENSEI!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : SENSEI!!!!!!!

lines.en: : Ami?...What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : Ami?……怎么了?

lines.en: : Everything! Everything is wrong!
lines.zh: : 全都不对!全都不对劲!

lines.en: : Slow down. Start from the-
lines.zh: : 慢点说。从头——

lines.en: : I don’t know where I am!
lines.zh: : 我不知道我在哪!

lines.en: : How can you not know where you are? You weren’t kidnapped, were you?
lines.zh: : 你怎么会不知道你在哪?你不会是被绑架了吧?

lines.en: : No, you idiot! I came here myself! But I don’t know how to get back and I’m too scared to move!
lines.zh: : 不是,你个笨蛋!是我自己来的!但我不知道怎么回去,我吓得不敢动!

lines.en: : Have you tried your GPS-
lines.zh: : 你试过导航——

lines.en: : Of course! Stop thinking I’m such an idiot! It’s just not working and it won’t tell me where I am and I need you to come get me!
lines.zh: : 当然试了!别把我当白痴!导航就是不好使,它不告诉我我在哪,我需要你来接我!

lines.en: : But how am I supposed to do that if you don’t know where you are? Kumon-mi is huge. I need a hint or...something at the very least.
lines.zh: : 可是你不知道自己在哪,我怎么接?Kumon-mi 这么大。至少给个提示……或者什么的。

lines.en: : I think this is...the old district?
lines.zh: : 我觉得这里是……老城区?

lines.en: : No, I’m sure it is. That’s where I am. But I don’t know how to leave and I’m too scared to even walk right now. My legs are shaking so much. Can you please come help me? Please?
lines.zh: : 不,我确定是。因为你就在老城区。但我不知道怎么出去,我现在连走路都不敢。我的腿抖得不行。你能来接我吗?求你了?

lines.en: : What are you even doing all the way over there?
lines.zh: : 你跑那么远去那边干什么?

lines.en: : I don’t know! I was just doing what I was told!
lines.zh: : 我不知道!我就是照吩咐做的!

lines.en: : By who? Who would ask you to go all the way over there and why would you listen to them in the-
lines.zh: : 谁吩咐的?谁会叫你跑去那种地方,而你为什么还听——

lines.en: : ARE YOU COMING OR NOT?!
lines.zh: : 你到底来不来?!

lines.en: Her voice sounds different than normal, and not just because it’s panicked.
lines.zh: 她的声音听起来不太对劲,而且不只是慌。

lines.en: It’s like her mouth was stuffed with worms and all of the worms are screaming at the same time but when they open their worm-mouths more worms come out and basically it just sounds like worms.
lines.zh: 那感觉像她的嘴里塞满了虫子,而所有的虫子同时在尖叫;可它们一张开虫嘴,钻出来的又是更多的虫子——总之,听起来就是一片虫。

lines.en: This is a job for the worm-man.
lines.zh: 这是属于虫子侠的工作。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’ll head over now. Just try and figure out where you are in the meantime, okay?
lines.zh: : 好,我现在过去。你试着在原地弄清方位,好吗?

lines.en: I’m glad my worms still come out normal despite being the word-man.
lines.zh: 我很庆幸,身为文字侠,我的虫子吐出来还是正常的。

lines.en: Wait, no. I got that backwards.
lines.zh: 等等,不对。我说反了。

lines.en: Hold on. I will fix.
lines.zh: 稍等。我来修复。

lines.en: The only way to bring life back to normal is with a bus ride backwards.
lines.zh: 让生活回归正常的唯一办法,是坐一趟倒退的公交。

lines.en: It’s a poem again, but a lack of rhyming words has forced in blackbirds.
lines.zh: 这又是一首诗,但找不到押韵的词,只好硬塞进几只黑鸟。

lines.en: But birds are all I talk about, so let’s try discussing...placards?
lines.zh: 可我满口都是鸟。那我们来聊点……标语牌?

lines.en: No! That’s not exciting either! Here! Just take the fucking password!
lines.zh: 不!那个也不带劲!得了!把该死的通关暗号拿去!

lines.en: : Do you believe in God?
lines.zh: : 你信神吗?

lines.en: : Of course. How else would we have gotten here?
lines.zh: : 当然。不然你以为我们是怎么走到这里的?

lines.en: : How do you think He feels when we defy Him?
lines.zh: : 你觉得,当我们违逆祂时,祂是什么感觉?

lines.en: : Technically speaking, God would likely be genderless. God is an entity who exists on a plane so far detached from human life that merely comparing It to us is disrespectful.
lines.zh: : 严格来说,神多半是无性的。神是存在于一个与人类生活彻底脱节之平面上的存在,光是拿祂与我们作比,都是一种失敬。

lines.en: : But weren’t we all created in His image?
lines.zh: : 可我们不都是照着祂的形象造的吗?

lines.en: : Its image. And I think not.
lines.zh: : 是「祂」的形象。而且我觉得不是。

lines.en: : I think God is so wonderful that looking at It would blind us. It is so bright and so powerful that we can not even comprehend It.
lines.zh: : 我觉得神美好到注视祂就会让我们失明。祂那么明亮、那么强大,我们根本无法理解。

lines.en: : Is Mom with God now?
lines.zh: : 妈妈现在和神在一起吗?

lines.en: She is.
: Jeez, you’re really going through it tonight, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 天哪,你今晚真的过得很糟,是吧?

lines.en: : Any reason why? Something I can help with?
lines.zh: : 有什么原因吗?有我能帮上忙的吗?
: 为什么?……

lines.en: : Why what?
lines.zh: : 为什么什么?

lines.en: : Why do I keep seeing you?
lines.zh: : 为什么我总见到你?

lines.en: : Because you’re lucky.
lines.zh: : 因为你幸运。

lines.en: : Not everybody gets regular chances to spend time with their dead girlfriend, you know. You should be savoring moments like these.
lines.zh: : 不是每个人都有机会定期和死去的女友相处的,你知道吧。你应该珍惜这种时刻。

lines.en: : How could I?!
lines.zh: : 我怎么珍惜?!

lines.en: : Oh my. You never raise your voice — especially at me. You must feel pretty strongly about this.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。你从来不高声说话——尤其是对我。看来你对这件事感情很深。

lines.en: : Here, maybe this will cheer you up! You still like costumes, don’t you? There’s no way such a cute-
lines.zh: : 给,也许这个能让你打起精神!你还喜欢换装,对吧?这么可爱的——

lines.en: : Actually, wait. Isn’t this costume kinda...half-assed?
lines.zh: : 等等。这套衣服是不是有点……敷衍?

lines.en: : Whatever! Screw it! Come at me with all you’ve got, big guy!
lines.zh: : 无所谓!豁出去了!使出你的全力放马过来吧,大块头!

lines.en: : Leave...
: Please...
lines.zh: : 求你……

lines.en: : Meow?
: I don’t...want to see you anymore...
lines.zh: : 我……不想再见到你了……

lines.en: : Hissssssssssssss...
: Hah...fine. I’ll go back to my never-ending pool of darkness. Left to float there forever and ever and ever and ever, totally unfulfilled.
lines.zh: : 哈……好吧。我回我那片无尽的黑暗水池里去。永远漂在那里,漂到天荒地老,一无所成。

lines.en: : I always knew Heaven was a joke, but it would have been really cool if there was at least something after death.
lines.zh: : 我一直知道天堂是个笑话,但如果死后至少还有点什么,那该多酷。

lines.en: : Here’s the thing though, Aki-kun. You can’t just ignore me forever. Especially now that you’re literally seeing me.
lines.zh: : 不过是这样,阿贵。你不能永远无视我。尤其是现在,你都看见我了。

lines.en: : Does this really look like moving on to you? All you’re doing is making things harder for yourself.
lines.zh: : 在你眼里,这真的像是在走出来吗?你只是在把事情变得更难而已。

lines.en: : Well, what else am I supposed to do?!
lines.zh: : 那我还能怎么办?!

lines.en: : How should I know? I’m a cat. Meow.
lines.zh: : 我怎么知道?我是只猫。喵。

lines.en: : Whatever it is, though, you’re not going to find it here.
lines.zh: : 但不管答案是什么,你都不会在这里找到。

lines.en: : Then where?...
lines.zh: : 那在哪?……

lines.en: : Where will I find it?...
lines.zh: : 我会在哪里找到它?……

lines.en: : I think you already know that.
lines.zh: : 我想你心里已经有数了。

lines.en: : You found me...
lines.zh: : 你找到我了……

lines.en: : And I didn’t even give you any hints...
lines.zh: : 而且我连提示都没给你……

lines.en: : Ami...what are you doing out here? It’s the middle of the night and we’re miles away from home. You know this place isn’t safe.
lines.zh: : Ami……你跑来这里干什么?现在是半夜,这里离家好几里。你知道这地方不安全。

lines.en: : I didn’t come here on my own, though! This wasn’t my idea!
lines.zh: : 我不是自己要来的!这不是我的主意!

lines.en: : Then whose idea was it?
lines.zh: : 那是谁的主意?

lines.en: : Maya and Ayane’s!
lines.zh: : Maya 和 Ayane 的!

lines.en: : ...What?
: They asked me to hang out tonight and told me to meet up with them here...but when I showed up, there was no one there.
lines.zh: : 她们约我今晚一起玩,让我来这里碰头……可我到了,一个人都没有。

lines.en: : So I called them and they didn’t answer....
lines.zh: : 于是我给她们打电话,没人接……

lines.en: : And when I looked at my GPS it wouldn’t work...
lines.zh: : 然后我看导航,导航也用不了……

lines.en: : And I forgot where I was and couldn’t find my way back, so I got even more lost! And then people were staring at me, so I got scared! And I still don’t know where they are and-
lines.zh: : 然后我忘了自己在哪,找不到回去的路,越走越迷!然后周围的人一直盯着我看,我吓坏了!而且我现在还是不知道她们在哪,然后——

lines.en: : And why did they do this to me?! Weren’t they supposed to be my friends?!
lines.zh: : 她们为什么要这样对我?!她们不是我的朋友吗?!

lines.en: : I’m sure it’s just some sort of misunderstanding.
lines.zh: : 我确定这只是个误会。

lines.en: : It’s not! I tried to tell you the other day, but they’ve been all kinds of mean to me lately!
lines.zh: : 才不是!前几天我就想跟你说了,她们最近对我各种刻薄!

lines.en: : They’re bullying me! Leaving me out of things I’d always be included in! And neither of them is telling me why! So why?! Why are they doing this?!
lines.zh: : 她们在欺负我!把我从以前一直有我的活动里排除出去!而且她们谁都不肯告诉我为什么!为什么?!为什么她们要这样?!

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: : I just want my friends back!!!!!!!!! Waaaahhhhhhhhahahahh!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 我只要我的朋友回来!!!!!!!!!哇啊啊啊啊啊啊啊!!!!!!!

lines.en: : Give me a minute. I’ll call them and see what’s going on. I’m sure it’s-
lines.zh: : 给我一点时间。我给她们打个电话,看看怎么回事。我确信只是——

lines.en: : What’s wrong?...
lines.zh: : 怎么了?……

lines.en: : My phone’s dead.
lines.zh: : 我手机没电了。

lines.en: : Really?...
lines.zh: : 真的吗?……

lines.en: : It was fine when I left Kaori’s apartment. I don’t get how-
lines.zh: : 我离开 Kaori 公寓的时候还好好的。我不明白——

lines.en: : What were you doing at Kaori’s apartment?
lines.zh: : 你在 Kaori 的公寓干什么?

lines.en: : Does that really matter right now?
lines.zh: : 这件事现在真的很重要吗?

lines.en: : Were you having sex with her?
lines.zh: : 你和她上床了吗?

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : Do you and Kaori have sex together? Are you going to leave me for her?
lines.zh: : 你和 Kaori 做了吗?你要为了她离开我吗?

lines.en: : I don’t see how that’s relevant at all, but no. We don’t. And I’d appreciate it if you wouldn’t ask me questions like that anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得这有任何相关性,但没有。我们没有。还有,请你以后别再问我这种问题了。

lines.en: : Is that why you won’t have sex with me? Because you’re too busy having sex with Kaori?
lines.zh: : 所以这就是你不和我做的原因?因为你忙着和 Kaori 做?

lines.en: : Did you know she used to post pictures of herself on the Internet? I bet she’s had sex with lots of people. You shouldn’t do that kind of thing with her. It’s not safe.
lines.zh: : 你知道她以前在网上发自己的照片吗?我打赌她和很多人做过。你不该跟她做那种事。不安全。

lines.en: : Kaori’s an...interesting character. But if you think that’s the type of person she is, you’re way off.
lines.zh: : Kaori 是个……挺特别的角色。但你要是觉得她是那种人,那你错得离谱。

lines.en: : Did she tell you that? Is that how she got you to have sex with her?
lines.zh: : 是她这么跟你说的吗?她就是这么把你骗上床的?

lines.en: : Ami, I’ve never done anything like that with Kaori. And I’d appreciate it if you wouldn’t ask me questions like that anymore.
lines.zh: : Ami,我和 Kaori 从来没做过那种事。还有,请你以后别再问我这种问题了。

lines.en: : I only ask things like that because I love you.
lines.zh: : 我问这种问题,是因为我爱你。

lines.en: : Well, please love me in a less intrusive way.
lines.zh: : 那请你用一种不那么侵犯人的方式来爱我。

lines.en: : Do you think I’m a burden, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我是个负担吗,Sensei?

lines.en: : Do you think Maya and Ayane are leaving me behind because I’m slowing them down? Or keeping them from doing the things they like?
lines.zh: : 你觉得 Maya 和 Ayane 抛下我,是因为我拖累了她们吗?还是挡了她们喜欢的事?

lines.en: : You’re not going to do that too...are you? You’re not going to leave me?
lines.zh: : 你不会也……那样做的……对吧?你不会离开我的,对吧?

lines.en: : I’m not going to leave you. You’re a part of me.
lines.zh: : 我不会离开你。你是我的一部分。

lines.en: : Your organs are a part of you. And if one of them stops doing its job, it can kill you.
lines.zh: : 器官也是你的一部分。要是其中一个罢工,它能要你的命。

lines.en: : So you can either get a new organ to replace the failing one or, in some cases, have it removed altogether.
lines.zh: : 所以你要么换个新器官顶替罢工的那个,要么,在某些情况下,干脆把它整个切掉。

lines.en: : Is that what I am to you? An organ you can just give up? A body part you can just cut off?
lines.zh: : 在你眼里,我就是那种东西吗?一个说放弃就能放弃的器官?一块说切就能切掉的肢体?

lines.en: : No...you’re not like that at all.
lines.zh: : 不……你完全不是那样。

lines.en: : So you’re saying you can’t live without me?
lines.zh: : 那你是说,没有我你活不下去?

lines.en: : If that’s what makes you happy, sure.
lines.zh: : 如果那样能让你高兴,行。

lines.en: : Say it.
lines.zh: : 说出来。

lines.en: : Say you can’t live without me.
lines.zh: : 说你离不开我。

lines.en: : I can’t live without you.
lines.zh: : 我离不开你。

lines.en: : Really?...
lines.zh: : 真的吗?……

lines.en: : Of course...
lines.zh: : 当然……

lines.en: : I can’t live without you either.
lines.zh: : 我也离不开你。

lines.en: : Yeah...I can see that.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我看得出来。

lines.en: : I, umm...I know you don’t like when I ask things like this, but...can you maybe...give me a piggyback ride home? I’m not sure how well my legs will work right now.
lines.zh: : 那个,呃……我知道你不喜欢我提这种要求,但是……能不能……背我回家?我不确定我的腿现在还听不听使唤。

lines.en: : You really can’t walk on your own?
lines.zh: : 你真的没法自己走?

lines.en: : I probably can, just...it’ll be really slow and I don’t want to annoy you. Plus, having a shoulder to dry my tears on would be a really big help.
lines.zh: : 我大概可以,只是……会特别慢,而且我不想惹你烦。再说,有个肩膀让我擦眼泪,会帮大忙的。

lines.en: : Then...fine. But only because you look pathetic right now and I feel kind of bad for you.
lines.zh: : 那……好吧。但只是因为你现在看起来实在太惨,我有点可怜你。

lines.en: : I’ll take what I can get...
lines.zh: : 能捞多少是多少……

lines.en: : Thank you, Sensei...I know you hate doing stuff like this.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你,Sensei……我知道你讨厌做这种事。

lines.en: : I hope I’m not too heavy.
lines.zh: : 希望我没有太重。

lines.en: Ami rests atop my shoulders and, just as the tongue of the accused did mere hours (or less) ago, steals away the unrest that I’ve been feeling.
lines.zh: Ami 趴在我的肩头,一如几小时(或者更短)之前那个罪人的舌头,偷走了我一直在忍受的不安。

lines.en: It’s as if her body is a dam — and all of the worries in all of the world have once again been liquefied only to get caught up behind this brand new barrier.
lines.zh: 仿佛她的身体是一道水坝——全世界所有的忧虑再一次被液化,全部拦在了这道崭新的堤坝之后。

lines.en: I wonder if that’s why we’re in here.
lines.zh: 我想,我们被困在这里,是不是就是这个原因。

lines.en: Maybe it doesn’t have anything to do with the war at all.
lines.zh: 也许这一切跟战争根本无关。

lines.en: Maybe the walls of Kumon-mi are our dam, and the world outside of them is simply too full of horrible things to warrant letting any of them in.
lines.zh: 也许 Kumon-mi 的城墙就是我们的水坝,而外面的世界装满了太多可怕的东西,不值得放进任何一个。

lines.en: While this thought softens the beat of my heart, I know it’s not a good thought to have. And I know it can’t be true.
lines.zh: 这个念头让我心跳一软,但我知道它不是个好念头。我也知道它不可能是真的。

lines.en: Things aren’t always exactly as they seem. I’ve lost track of how many times I’ve had to tell you that.
lines.zh: 事情不总像表面那样。我已经数不清自己把这句话对你讲过多少次了。

lines.en: But there are certain things I can’t help but feel like are exactly as they seem.
lines.zh: 但有些东西,我总觉得它们就像表面那样。

lines.en: The walls.
lines.zh: 城墙。

lines.en: The sky. The moon. The earth.
lines.zh: 天空。月亮。大地。

lines.en: But more importantly than all of that-
lines.zh: 而比这一切都更重要的——

lines.en: How much I love my niece.
lines.zh: 是我多爱我的侄女。

lines.en: Just look at her.
lines.zh: 你看她。

lines.en: Isn’t she the cutest?
lines.zh: 她是不是最可爱的?

lines.en: Isn’t she the cutest?
lines.zh: 她是不是最可爱的?

lines.en: Isn’t she the cutest?
lines.zh: 她是不是最可爱的?

lines.en: She is.
lines.zh: 她是。

lines.en: : Heheh...
lines.zh: : 呵呵……

lines.en: : This reminds me a lot of when I was younger...
lines.zh: : 这让我想起小时候……

lines.en: : Did you ride on my shoulders a lot like this back then?
lines.zh: : 那时候,你也经常这样让我骑在肩上吗?

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 并没有。

lines.en: : My dad would hold me like this when we were going on walks in the park, but that’s not really something I ever got to experience with you.
lines.zh: : 去公园散步的时候,爸爸会这样扛我,但这种体验,和你之间一直没有过。

lines.en: : It would have been nice if I did. But that would also mean my parents would have been taken away earlier than they were and...
lines.zh: : 要是有过就好了。但那也意味着,我的父母会提前被带走,而且……

lines.en: : And...
lines.zh: : 而且……

lines.en: : B-But that didn’t mean I never fantasized about it! I always looked forward to seeing you when you came over! And I still think about, like...riding on your shoulders and stuff now.
lines.zh: : 可、可这也不代表我没幻想过!你每次来的时候,我都很期待见到你!就连现在,我偶尔还会想……骑在你肩上什么的。

lines.en: : We just never had a chance to when we were finally put together.
lines.zh: : 只等我们终于住到一起,反而再也没有机会了。

lines.en: : But you’d still hold me tight sometimes...
lines.zh: : 但你有时候还是会抱紧我……

lines.en: : And I’d fall asleep in your arms...
lines.zh: : 而我会在你怀里睡着……

lines.en: : But then it was right back to normal.
lines.zh: : 然后第二天,一切又回到老样子。

lines.en: : But normal was never normal.
lines.zh: : 可老样子从来就不正常。

lines.en: : And it isn’t normal today either.
lines.zh: : 到今天,也还是不正常。

lines.en: : I tried to change things sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我有时候试过改变它。

lines.en: : I thought I knew what you wanted.
lines.zh: : 我以为我知道你想要什么。

lines.en: : But I was a stupid little girl.
lines.zh: : 但我那时候只是个笨手笨脚的小女孩。

lines.en: : I didn’t understand what you wanted at all.
lines.zh: : 我完全没有理解你想要什么。

lines.en: : But now I do.
lines.zh: : 但现在我懂了。

lines.en: : Now, I know that all you really want is to feel safe.
lines.zh: : 现在,我知道你真正想要的,只是安全感。

lines.en: : So I built a world where you could.
lines.zh: : 所以我搭了一个你能安全的世界。

lines.en: : I made our house into a home. I filled it to the brim with your favorite foods and activities. And all I’ve ever asked for in exchange for all of that is your attention.
lines.zh: : 我把我们的房子变成了家。我用你最喜欢的食物和消遣把它填得满满当当。而这一切,我要的回报只有你的注意。

lines.en: : And I know it might seem like I ask for a little too much attention sometimes. And I’m sorry for that.
lines.zh: : 我知道,有时候我的索求看上去有点过分。对不起。

lines.en: : I’m a very needy girl.
lines.zh: : 我是个需求很大的女孩。

lines.en: : And that’s why I’m so scared now. Because, sometimes...it feels like you’re trying to run away.
lines.zh: : 这也是我如今这么害怕的原因。因为,有时候……我感觉你在试图逃走。

lines.en: : How come?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : Did what you want change?
lines.zh: : 是你想要的变了吗?

lines.en: : Do I not understand you as much as I used to?
lines.zh: : 是我对你的理解,不如从前了吗?

lines.en: : If there’s something I’m missing, tell me.
lines.zh: : 如果有我漏掉的东西,告诉我。

lines.en: : I’d do anything for you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我什么都愿意为你做,Sensei。

lines.en: : And I mean anything.
lines.zh: : 我是真的指任何事。

lines.en: : You do more than enough, Ami.
lines.zh: : 你做得已经足够多了,Ami。

lines.en: : But for now, I want to go home and sleep. So just stay put and try not to move around too much. It makes walking hard.
lines.zh: : 但现在,我想回家睡觉。所以乖乖待好,别乱动。你乱动我不好走。

lines.en: : Okay...I’m tired too.
lines.zh: : 好……我也累了。

lines.en: : Besides, who needs friends anyway? All I’ve ever really needed is you.
lines.zh: : 再说了,谁还需要朋友呢?我真正需要的从来只有你。

lines.en: : And I’m sure you feel the same about me. Don’t you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 而你对我肯定也一样。对吧,Sensei?

lines.en: : Yeah, sure. Whatever.
lines.zh: : 行,是是是。随便。

lines.en: : Say it with a little more sincerity, please. Repeat after me, “Ami is the ultimate niece-“
lines.zh: : 请再说得走心一点。跟我念:「Ami 是终极侄女——」

lines.en: : Ami is the ultimate niece...
lines.zh: : Ami 是终极侄女……

lines.en: : “And the only one I’ll ever love.”
lines.zh: : 「也是我此生唯一所爱。」

lines.en: : And...the only one I’ll ever love.
lines.zh: : 也是……我此生唯一所爱。

lines.en: : Heh...
: Heheheh...
lines.zh: : 呵呵呵……

lines.en: : Hahah! Hahahahahaha! Hahaha!
lines.zh: : 哈哈!哈哈哈哈哈哈!哈哈!

lines.en: : What are you cracking up about up there?
lines.zh: : 你在上面笑什么?

lines.en: : Hahahahahah!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈!

lines.en: : It’s just...hahahahahahah! It's just so crazy how much I love you!
lines.zh: : 就是……哈哈哈哈哈哈!我好爱你,爱到离谱!

lines.en: : How are you not laughing?! I’m so obsessed it’s kind of hilarious!
lines.zh: : 你怎么笑不出来?!我这么痴迷,简直太好笑了!

lines.en: : Yeah, well...
lines.zh: : 是嘛……

lines.en: : It’s a little less funny when you’re the one being obsessed over...
lines.zh: : 当被痴迷的人是你的时候,就没那么好笑了……

lines.en: : Heheh...heh...
: I don’t know about that, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 那可说不准,Sensei……
